_comment: MG-23 blocker 1 fixture — MUST FAIL (nonzero). THE fail-open hole this fixture pins: resource_changes is a STRING, not an array. Before the fix this document exited 0. The old structural probe only tested PRESENCE (`.resource_changes? != null`), which is TRUE for a string; the collector then reached in with `.resource_changes[]?`, whose `?` suppressed the 'cannot iterate over string' error and yielded nothing; the gate walked zero resource_changes entries and printed PASS. A malformed or truncated-then-repaired plan document must never be able to buy a PASS by being the wrong TYPE.
